title: This Spider Swings a Sticky Ball and Smells Like a Female Moth
subject: bolas spider

scenes.text: This spider doesn't build a web. It swings a ball on a string.
The ball is a sticky droplet about 2.5 millimetres across.
It also smells like a female moth.
Male moths follow the scent in the dark, flying straight into the swing.
Two moth species make up over 90 percent of what one bolas spider eats.
It even changes the scent through the night to match the moth that is flying.
